what_this_change_does: Corrects trailing Python comment ownership and rejects directory forms that cannot be represented faithfully as the generated local Markdown links. It also leaves metadata-fence headroom so supported long-backtick headings remain renderable.

resolved_findings.assessment: Comment tokens beyond an AST endpoint are included only for multiline suites and only when indented beyond the owner. Scanning stops at the next non-comment, non-newline token. Comparing expanded raw indentation prefixes with Python's eight-column tab stops fixes the follow-up mixed-tabs case while preserving original code-point coordinates.
resolved_findings.regression_tests_read: The parameterized trailing-comment test covers function EOF comments, method comments before a sibling, class-only comments after a method, dedented module comments, inline suites and mixed tab/space indentation.

resolved_findings.assessment: The builder now rejects fragment/query markers, percent escapes, backslashes and ampersands, including Markdown entity spellings. It also rejects a leading double slash, which would create a scheme-relative URI. The one directory guard applies to current, previous and next links because all share the validated directory and restricted reading ID.
resolved_findings.regression_tests_read: The directory-character test covers #, ?, %, backslash and &. A separate test rejects //tmp/context.

resolved_findings.assessment: Metadata chunks are now at most 75 code points. A maximum 75-backtick run therefore requires at most a 76-backtick fence, leaving four code points for text within the 80-character opening line. Source chunks already leave more headroom through their coordinate prefixes.
resolved_findings.regression_tests_read: A supported heading containing 160 consecutive backticks retains its exact title and full-source reconstruction while every returned page satisfies both bounds.

compatibility: The prior independent static comparison found the original build_reading source-row extraction mechanically equivalent to 42ab414. benchmarks/review_readings.py has the same hash in this follow-up snapshot, so that conclusion remains applicable.
lean: No simplification warranted. The corrections address concrete ownership, link-fidelity and page-budget failures without adding public verification machinery.
